description: IAG Employee Document App - XSUAA configuration

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.DocumentView
scopes.description: View own employee documents (payslips, contracts, myFlex)

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.DocumentUpload
scopes.description: Upload documents on behalf of employees (HR use)

role-templates.name: Employee
role-templates.description: Standard employee — read-only access to own documents

role-templates.name: HRAdmin
role-templates.description: HR Administrator — can view and upload documents

role-collections.name: BTPOC_Employee
role-collections.description: Assign to all employees who should access their documents

role-collections.name: BTPOC_HRAdmin
role-collections.description: Assign to HR team members who manage documents
